name: dsh-conversation-folders
description: DSH 插件：每个会话一个专属文件夹 + 对话记录存档 + 空闲后自动分类归档 + 归档后原路径仍可点开 + 输出目录 + 菜单内删除对话。首次使用会话时在工作区下创建以对话标题命名的文件夹（标题未就绪时先用 `会话-<短ID>`，空闲后自动改名），把会话工作目录指过去（对话产生的所有文件都落在里面），并自动把对话内容写入 `对话记录.md`；输出目录（可选）默认不自动弹窗——需要时在侧栏「会话文件夹」面板点「选择输出目录」或调接口手动弹出系统目录选择框（也可配置 autoPromptOutputDir: true 恢复对话开始时自动弹），每次整理后把生产文件（`调研<N>_<原名>`）复制一份到 `<输出目录>/<会话文件夹名>/` 方便直接提取；对话结束、长时间没有新任务后，才把新增的表格、图表、文档等文件按类别分文件夹存放并自动命名，并在原路径保留硬链接/目录联接，对话里点击旧文件链接依旧能直接打开；删除会话时连同文件夹、输出目录副本及全部内容彻底删除。| DSH plugin: one dedicated folder per conversation (named after the conversation title), transcript archiving, idle-time auto-categorization, original-path entries after archiving, a user-chosen output directory, and a delete action in the session menu. On first use, creates a folder in the workspace and redirects the conversation working directory into it, writing the transcript to `对话记录.md`; the optional output directory is not prompted automatically by default — open the system folder picker from the sidebar “会话文件夹” panel button / the API when needed (set autoPromptOutputDir: true to restore the automatic prompt at conversation start), and after each organize the produced files (`调研<N>_<original>`) are copied to `<output dir>/<session folder name>/` for easy extraction; only after the conversation has been idle for a while are loose files (tables, charts, documents, ...) moved into category subfolders with automatic names, keeping entry points (hard link / directory junction) at the original paths so old file links in the conversation still open directly; a "Delete conversation and its contents" row in the session menu permanently removes the conversation, its folder, its output-dir copies, and everything else.

scripts.check: node --check lib/index.js && node --check lib/fs-helpers.js && node --check lib/state-store.js && node --check lib/organize.js && node --check lib/transcript.js && node --check client.js && node test/run-tests.mjs && node test/smoke-test.mjs
